scope: All 275 mapped Charlemagne parcels and 61 recorded legal-entity identifiers reviewed for Tier 1, including commune edges in all bundle communes, the cadastral named-area audit and the #461 historical extension. The one notice-index candidate was read from its page image and rejected; no exact notice event is assigned. Producer/company research remains Tier 2. No current farmer is verified.

sources.title: DGFiP department 21 legal-entity rights, 2025-01-01
sources.finding: Exact current references and every holder/right code retained. Rights are not farming.

sources.title: DGFiP available annual legal-entity rights
sources.finding: Pinned annual source members and original-reference dates are in rights-history.json and the shared inventory.

sources.title: Etalab available commune geometry vintages
sources.finding: Full current geometry is preserved. Earlier observations support separately labelled spatial inference.

sources.title: Cerema DVF+ open-data, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté
sources.finding: Dated deed references, without prices or parties. Coverage is audited independently of DFI.

sources.title: EARL Domaine Philippe Girard application receipt, dossier 2021-122
sources.finding: The receipt prints A139 under Chambolle-Musigny; its Aloxe-Corton references are L94, L24, L25, H59, E32 and E19. Aloxe-Corton A0139 is not named, so no event is assigned to this cru.
